fields.label: Stage
fields.description: As the planning page names it, e.g. Knitting, Dyeing, Finishing.

fields.label: Usual route
fields.description: Which learned figure is used when learned days are allowed. Set from history (whichever has more orders) unless you change it.

fields.label: In-house days
fields.description: Days from Work Order to finished output in your own factory. Used when the stage's usual route is In-house, and on plans where a level is made in-house.

fields.label: Job-work services
fields.description: Service items bought when this stage is job work, comma-separated (e.g. DYEING, or DRYER, STENTER). Filled nightly from your Purchase Material Requests where empty.

fields.label: Job work days
fields.description: Days from sending to a job worker to receiving the output back. Used when the stage's usual route is Job work, and on plans where a level goes to job work.
